title: Pluto's Latest Surface Liquid Flow Revealed

scenes.text: Pluto’s surface just flashed with fresh liquid!

scenes.label: FIRST DETECTED LIQUID
scenes.text: Scientists captured the first evidence of liquid flowing on Pluto’s surface in 2024.

scenes.label: RAIN OF ICE DRIPS
scenes.text: The flow appears as a thin sheet of water‑ice, similar to methane rain on Titan.

scenes.label: SPEED OF 1 KM/H
scenes.text: The liquid moves at about 1 km/h, enough to reshape the terrain over millennia.
Follow if curiosity runs your brain.

description: Pluto’s icy surface is not as static as once thought—fresh liquid flows have been observed. Follow for daily science!
